findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Weak cryptographic algorithms
 * @description Using weak cryptographic algorithms like MD5 or SHA1 can lead to security vulnerabilities
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/weak-crypto
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-327
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  call = API::moduleImport("hashlib").getMember(["md5", "sha1"]).getACall()
select call, "Use of weak cryptographic algorithm that may be vulnerable to collision attacks."

findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Unsafe dynamic code execution
 * @description Using exec, eval, or compile with untrusted input can lead to arbitrary code execution
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity error
 * @id py/unsafe-dynamic-code
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-094
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  call = API::builtin(["exec", "eval", "compile"]).getACall() or
  call = API::moduleImport("os").getMember("system").getACall() or
  call = API::moduleImport("subprocess").getMember(["call", "run", "Popen"]).getACall()
select call, "Potentially unsafe dynamic code execution operation."
findings.hypothesis: Unsafe dynamic code execution via exec, eval, compile, os.system, or subprocess
